definitions.explanation: The fat content in food or the body; a class of nutrients that includes fats and oils used for energy storage and cell function.

examples.japanese: {脂質|ししつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's be careful not to consume too much fat.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脂質|ししつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でヘルシーだ。
examples.english: This product is healthy because it's low in fat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脂質|ししつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{含有量|がんゆうりょう}→含有量：22566_ganyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make sure to check the fat content on the nutrition label before buying.

notes:
USAGE:
{脂質|ししつ} is the standard nutritional/scientific term for fats and lipids, commonly seen on Japanese food labels. In everyday speech, people more often say ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (fat) or ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil/grease).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脂質|ししつ}{異常症|いじょうしょう} (dyslipidemia — high cholesterol/triglycerides)
- {脂質|ししつ}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧ (zero fat)
- {脂質|ししつ}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (fat restriction)

RELATED NUTRITION TERMS:
- ⟦{糖質|とうしつ}→糖質：11091_toushitsu⟧ (carbohydrates)
- たんぱく⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (protein)
- ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (body fat, dietary fat — more everyday term)
